pages.text: Crafted from Blighted Spirit and a Heart of the Sea, this item holds a witch’s resolve to share the White Priestess’s burden.$(br2)To soothe this blight, hold it in your offhand and kill at least three Drowned, Blighted Drowned, or Blighted Witches.
pages.title: 疲惫的心

pages.text: $(#777777)当她快被孤独与他人的期望逼到边缘时，$()$(br)$(#777777)她遇见了一名叫泉之白巫女的少女。$()
